text.p: The docking settings can be set to be suit the current monitor setup quickly, or set to custom behavior.
To understand the difference between different variants, see the section on User Interface.

ul.li: Default - In this mode, new views will open in up to four different tab groups to begin with. Additional views are docked (stacked) in the tab groups.
New tab... - In this mode, new views are stacked as tabs in the main tab group.
Default - In this mode, some views are by default started as floating windows.
Start floating views docked as new tab - In this mode, all views are docked.
